note: Example data: an invented fitness app (Example Workout Log by Example Fitness Apps), not a real business or app. Every number in expected_output.json follows from this input.
request: Hey Claude, I just added the "app-rating-prompt-planner" skill. Our ratings dipped after 6.3. Check our current rating prompt against the store rules and plan when we should ask for ratings on iOS and Android.

releases.notes: Rest timer presets and a new exercise library.
Weekly plans. Android: new rating dialog.
New sync engine for workouts across devices.
Fixes workouts not syncing between devices after 6.3.0.

iOS: Calls requestReview on the 3rd app launch, at launch.
Settings has a Rate us button that calls requestReview.
No app-side limit; the app relies on the system cap.
Android: Since 6.2.0, on the 3rd app launch shows our own dialog: Enjoying Example Workout Log? Yes opens the in-app review card; No opens our feedback form.
Settings has a Rate us button that calls launchReviewFlow.
current_prompt_logic.feedback_route: Help, then Contact us (email). Android users who answer No to the dialog get a feedback form.
